AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VIII
Asterion Orbital Crew Member
You can tell which grids are gone from up here. The coast used to be almost continuous light. Now there are gaps hundreds of kilometers wide. Cyranth flickers. Karsic territory is worse.

Pelagos ports mostly went dark three nights ago. Atmospheric monitoring says the particulate layer is spreading. We still have power. Water. Food. Evercrop too, though all cultures are under isolation order.
Earth sends fewer messages every day. People keep asking whether we're safe. Safe is a strange word when everything you love is beneath you and burning.
We're alive. That's what we know.

AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VIII
Dr. Lena Orlov
To the Asterion Continuity Repository. Preserve everything. Not only the scientific records. Preserve ordinary things.

News broadcasts. Hospital schedules. Menus. School archives. Transportation maps. Music. Pictures of streets before the barricades. Do not let the future conclude our civilization existed only to become a cautionary tale.
People loved here. Worked here. Complained here. Built ridiculous things. Raised children. Cured diseases. Fed billions. Failed spectacularly.
If someone survives long enough to study us, make them understand both halves. The world was worth saving. That is why what happened matters.
